decision: DEC-11: separate generation and independent semantic judge attempts
rules: Normal successful/no-change valid analysis is two calls/two quota slots; rejects before judge may consume only generation.
Exact retries do not redispatch either durable attempt. Unknown outcomes require explicit reconciliation.
A08 generation-only journal is not a journaled independent verdict.
Traceability completion is not end-to-end acceptance; mapped unit/component fixtures do not establish provider/device/performance qualification.
Legacy external-v1 SQL fixtures cover publication mechanics only; independent endpoint/semantic suites cover DEC-11.
